title: What Makes a Good Speech
text:
A good speech begins with a strong opening that catches the attention of the audience. Many speakers start with a short story or a surprising question. After the opening, the speaker explains the main message in clear and simple words. A speech should not be too long, because listeners quickly lose interest.

The best speakers also use their voice and body language to support their words. They speak slowly, make eye contact, and pause before important points. Before the event, many people practice their speech in front of a mirror or a friend. This practice helps them feel more calm and confident on the day.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, what do many speakers use to start a speech?
options: A short story or a surprising question

questions.text: According to the second paragraph, what do the best speakers do before important points?
options: They read the whole speech aloud

questions.text: What can you infer about a speech that is too long?
options: The speaker will feel more nervous
The audience will ask for a longer speech

questions.text: Why might practicing in front of a friend help a speaker?
options: It makes the speech shorter automatically
It helps the speaker feel calmer on the day
It removes the need for an opening
It replaces the need for eye contact

vocabulary.definition: the first part of something, such as a speech
the people who listen to or watch a speech or performance
a short moment of silence before or between words
feeling sure about your own abilities

paragraph_translations: Um bom discurso começa com uma abertura forte que chama a atenção do público. Muitos oradores começam com uma história curta ou uma pergunta surpreendente. Depois da abertura, o orador explica a mensagem principal com palavras claras e simples. Um discurso não deve ser muito longo, porque os ouvintes perdem o interesse rapidamente.

Os melhores oradores também usam a voz e a linguagem corporal para apoiar suas palavras. Eles falam devagar, fazem contato visual e fazem uma pausa antes de pontos importantes. Antes do evento, muitas pessoas treinam o discurso diante de um espelho ou de um amigo. Esse treino ajuda a se sentirem mais calmas e confiantes no dia.
